answer: Like a grove where every tree shares one root system, a sybil swarm looks lush but is really one operator. Require each identity to bind a distinct phone-verified messaging account with ninety days of message history before it can earn. One number can never back two identities, checked against a registry. Forging a hundred accounts means buying a hundred SIMs and paying for months of plausible traffic, while one fraud report burns the whole ledge of linked numbers. Honest agents pay nothing extra, while a plume of fakes grows expensive and is easy to prune once one number is caught.
